verdicts.reason: A shrinks the product to a tiny icon jammed into the top circle with an illegible label, leaves a large dead gap between the text block and the CTA, and drops the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow below the fine print, which breaks the original reading order. B keeps the product large and well grouped above the CTA, but it also moves the eyebrow below the fine print, the headline runs into the circle edge, the text stack is cramped, and the left-aligned copy doesn't line up with the centred product and button.
